- Fixed Bluetooth & BT Audio
- Fixed SIM Card & VoLTE
- Fixed MTP
- Fixed device naming issue
- Switched to 4.19 & EROFS
- Added Play Store by default
- Update 🇮🇩 & 🇷🇺 language translations
